title: 今天早餐吃什么？
subtitle: 在校园早餐店里认识食物、表达选择，并完成一次自然点餐。
audience_summary: 适合已经会基本问候、数字和时间表达的初级学习者。
learning_objectives: 认识九个常见早餐词语
使用“我要……”和“你想吃什么？”完成点餐
听懂简单的早餐选择并作出回应

cards.example_translation: I would like two steamed buns.

cards.example_pinyin: Wǒ měitiān chī yí ge jīdàn.
cards.example_translation: I eat one egg every day.

cards.example_pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi niúnǎi.
cards.example_translation: Please give me a glass of milk.
Rice porridge is comforting in the morning.
You should eat some fruit for breakfast.
This bread is a little sweet.

cards.example_pinyin: Wǒ yào yì bēi rè dòujiāng.
cards.example_translation: I would like a cup of hot soy milk.

game.title: 早餐店快问快答
game.goal: 听懂早餐店里的具体需求，并选择最合适的词语或回答。
game.goal_translation: Understand a specific breakfast order and choose the best word or response.
instructions: 读问题，也可以请老师读给你听。
从三个选项中选择最合适的答案。
看反馈后，用完整句子跟读一次。
instructions_translation: Read the question or ask your teacher to read it aloud.
Choose the best answer from three options.
After the feedback, repeat the full sentence once.
game.teacher_tip: 第二轮遮住文字，由老师读题；学生只听声音作答。

questions.prompt_translation: Which one is something you drink?
questions.feedback_translation: Soy milk is something you drink.
The measure word ge can be used with steamed buns.

questions.prompt_translation: How do you say “hot soy milk”?
questions.feedback: 热豆浆就是 hot soy milk。
questions.feedback_translation: Rè dòujiāng means hot soy milk.

questions.prompt_pinyin: Nǎ yí ge tōngcháng yòng “yí ge”?
questions.prompt_translation: Which one commonly uses the measure word ge?
What would you like to eat?
questions.feedback: “我要面包”直接回答了食物选择。
questions.feedback_translation: Wǒ yào miànbāo directly answers the food choice.

questions.prompt: 哪一句最适合在早餐店说？
questions.prompt_pinyin: Nǎ yí jù zuì shìhé zài zǎocāndiàn shuō?
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence fits best in a breakfast shop?
questions.feedback_translation: Use qǐng gěi wǒ… when ordering.

reading.title: 上课前的早餐
paragraphs: 今天早上，安娜和小明去学校旁边的早餐店。小明问：“你想吃什么？”
安娜说：“我要一个鸡蛋、一个包子，还要一杯热豆浆。豆浆不要太甜。”小明买了面包、牛奶和水果。
他们吃完早餐去上课。安娜说：“米粥看起来也很好吃，我明天想试一试。”
paragraphs_pinyin: Jīntiān zǎoshang, Ānnà hé Xiǎomíng qù xuéxiào pángbiān de zǎocāndiàn. Xiǎomíng wèn: “Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme?”
Ānnà shuō: “Wǒ yào yí ge jīdàn, yí ge bāozi, hái yào yì bēi rè dòujiāng. Dòujiāng bú yào tài tián.” Xiǎomíng mǎi le miànbāo, niúnǎi hé shuǐguǒ.
Tāmen chī wán zǎocān qù shàngkè. Ānnà shuō: “Mǐzhōu kànqǐlái yě hěn hǎochī, wǒ míngtiān xiǎng shì yí shì.”
paragraphs_translation: This morning, Anna and Xiaoming go to the breakfast shop next to the school. Xiaoming asks, “What would you like to eat?”
Anna says, “I’d like an egg, a steamed bun, and a cup of hot soy milk. Please don’t make the soy milk too sweet.” Xiaoming buys bread, milk, and fruit.
After breakfast, they go to class. Anna says, “The rice porridge also looks delicious. I want to try it tomorrow.”

glossary.explanation: 用面做皮、里面有馅的蒸食。
鸡生的蛋，是常见的早餐食物。
米加很多水煮成的食物。
苹果、香蕉、橙子等都叫水果。
在一个地方或东西的附近一侧。

discussion_questions.question: 你平常早上吃什么？为什么？
discussion_questions.pinyin: Nǐ píngcháng zǎoshang chī shénme? Wèishénme?
discussion_questions.translation: What do you usually eat in the morning, and why?

discussion_questions.question: 如果你开一家早餐店，你会卖什么？
discussion_questions.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ kāi yì jiā zǎocāndiàn, nǐ huì mài shénme?
discussion_questions.translation: If you opened a breakfast shop, what would you sell?
discussion_questions.sentence_frame: 我的早餐店会卖……，还会卖……
discussion_questions.sentence_frame_pinyin: Wǒ de zǎocāndiàn huì mài…, hái huì mài…
discussion_questions.sentence_frame_translation: My breakfast shop would sell… and also…

teacher_flow: 5分钟：用早餐图片暖场，学生说出认识的食物。
12分钟：学习九张知识卡并做快速跟读。
10分钟：完成早餐店快问快答，第二轮改为听力。
10分钟：阅读课文，点击生词查看解释。
6分钟：两道开放问题，使用句型支架表达。
2分钟：学生用一句话总结今天想吃的早餐。
source_notes: 图片示例使用 Unsplash 公开图片链接；正式课程生成后仍需教师检查图片内容和授权要求。
